title: The ₹10 Chai That Costs ₹14 — Inflation Explained by Two Friends

• India CPI inflation, July 2026: 4.45% (up from 4.38% in June) — Trading Economics

• Nifty 50: 24,774 six-month high → 23,653 now, −4.5% — Yahoo Finance data
• Rule of 72: 72 ÷ 4.45 ≈ 16 years for prices to double
• Chai math: ₹10 × 1.0552^6 = ₹13.82 ≈ ₹14 (+40% in 6 years)
